svg.title: Walking the film graph
svg.desc: To answer who directed the movies that Tom Hanks acted in, the walk starts at Tom Hanks, follows starred_actors to his 32 films, follows directed_by to their 25 directors, and stops. A decision model makes each of the three choices.
svg.text: Question: “Who directed the movies that Tom Hanks acted in?”
At each step, a decision model chooses one connection to follow. These three decisions cost $0.000075 in total.
